title: DOOM
blurb: id Software's genre-defining shooter. Episode 1: Knee-Deep in the Dead.

title: Wolfenstein 3D
blurb: Escape Castle Wolfenstein. The granddaddy of the first-person shooter.

title: Rise of the Triad
blurb: The HUNT Begins. Ludicrous gibs, dog mode, and the Excalibat.

title: Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold
blurb: Wolf3D-engine sci-fi shooter. Hunt Dr. Goldfire across six episodes.

title: Commander Keen 4
blurb: Secret of the Oracle. Billy Blaze, 8-year-old genius, saves the galaxy.

title: Duke Nukem II
blurb: Apogee shareware run-and-gun. Duke vs. the Rigelatins. (Episode 1)

title: Cosmo's Cosmic Adventure
blurb: Apogee shareware. A little alien with suction-cup hands. (Episode 1)

title: Hocus Pocus
blurb: Apprentice wizard blasts through a fantasy world. Apogee shareware.

title: Jazz Jackrabbit
blurb: Epic's blazing-fast run-and-gun. A green rabbit with a blaster.

title: Crystal Caves
blurb: Mylo Steamwitz mines crystals across a hostile galaxy. Apogee shareware.

title: Secret Agent
blurb: Agent 006 1/2 vs. the Diabolical Society. Apogee shareware.

title: Tyrian 2000
blurb: Gorgeous vertical shmup with a deep weapon-upgrade system. Freeware.

title: Major Stryker
blurb: Horizontal Apogee shooter in the Defender lineage. Freeware.

title: Epic Pinball
blurb: Smooth-scrolling pinball with the legendary Android table. Shareware.

title: One Must Fall 2097
blurb: Robot-fighting tournament with upgradable pilots. Epic freeware classic.

title: Wacky Wheels
blurb: Apogee's Mario-Kart-style racer with weaponized critters. Shareware.

title: Scorched Earth
blurb: "The Mother of All Games." Turn-based tank artillery duels. Freeware.

title: Heretic
blurb: Raven's dark-fantasy shooter on the DOOM engine. Shareware E1.
note: Shareware E1 (HERETIC1.WAD). Extracted from DEICE self-installer at build time.

title: Descent
blurb: Six-degrees-of-freedom shooter through mining tunnels. Shareware demo.
note: 3-level shareware demo. DESCENT.EXE = 4GWPRO bound onto DESCENT.UBN at build time; PIG/HOG from multi-volume ARJ.

title: Raptor: Call of the Shadows
blurb: Apogee's slick vertical shooter with a between-mission cash shop. Shareware.
note: Shareware ep1. Executable is RAP.EXE + FILE0000/0001.GLB. Extracted from PKLITE .SHR self-installer at build time.

title: The Catacomb Abyss
blurb: Raycast first-person shooter from id co-founder John Carmack's Softdisk era; cast spells, blast undead.

title: Ken's Labyrinth
blurb: Goofy pre-Build-engine raycaster by Ken Silverman (later author of Duke3D's Build engine).

title: Bio Menace
blurb: Snake Logan vs. mutant-infested Metro City; Keen-engine arcade action by Jim Norwood.

title: God of Thunder
blurb: Zelda-like top-down puzzle-combat starring Thor, by Ron Davis / Adept (Software Creations).

title: Jill of the Jungle
blurb: Epic MegaGames' colorful jungle platformer; transform into a phoenix, frog, and fish.

title: Supaplex
blurb: Collect Infotrons and dodge Zonks/Snik-Snaks across 111 fiendish levels.

title: Realms of Chaos
blurb: Apogee fantasy platformer; switch between warrior Andrew and sorceress Elandra.

title: Dark Ages
blurb: Early Apogee EGA platformer trilogy; Prince Garloth battles the wizard Garn.

title: Commander Keen: Marooned on Mars
blurb: The shareware-era classic that put id Software on the map; 8-year-old Billy Blaze saves Earth.

title: ZZT
blurb: Tim Sweeney's ASCII-graphics adventure and editor — the game that founded Epic MegaGames.

title: Jetpack
blurb: Adept Software's jetpack-fueled gem-collector with a built-in level editor.

title: Math Rescue
blurb: Apogee math-learning platformer; recover stolen numbers from the Gruzzles.

title: Word Rescue
blurb: Companion to Math Rescue; match words to pictures while dodging Gruzzles.

title: Xargon
blurb: Allen Pilgrim's Epic platformer (a Jill-of-the-Jungle successor); explore three worlds as Malvineous.

title: Monster Bash
blurb: Johnny Dash rescues kidnapped pets from Count Chuck's monster mansion; spooky Apogee platformer.

title: Alien Carnage (Halloween Harry)
blurb: Flamethrower-toting Harry torches aliens and frees hostages; fast SubZero/Apogee action.

title: Pharaoh's Tomb
blurb: Whip-cracking Nevada Smith raids a booby-trapped tomb; early Apogee George-Broussard title.

title: Boppin'
blurb: Quirky block-matching puzzler starring Yeet and Boik; 3D Realms / Accursed Toys.

title: Death Rally
blurb: Remedy's breakthrough debut: weaponized top-down racing with a young Max-Payne-era pedigree.

title: The Adventures of Captain Comic
blurb: The freeware platformer that inspired Commander Keen; Comic hunts three treasures on Tambi.
